# Licenses

The app bundles dependencies which contain the following licenses:

## example-package - 1.0.0 (MIT)

Test fixture for the /admin router (ADR 0038): it stands in for the licence
notices file that the Vite build writes, and is not the real one. The
non-ASCII characters below prove that the file reaches the browser as UTF-8.
